title: Accelerate macOS Virtual Machines with Reims-vgpu
description: Reims-vgpu is an experimental virtual GPU for macOS guests. It lets macOS VMs use accelerated graphics instead of a basic framebuffer. By hooking into native drivers, it translates command streams directly into host Metal or Vulkan calls for peak performance on Linux and Apple Silicon.
